gate: G5 Stage 1 - EgoStitch minimum-viable model (imagination + degree budget + closure)
amendment_rationale: Replacement registration made before any held-out topology metric was produced. An unpublished fp32 feasibility rescore showed that the model has intrinsic exact-score ties (largest group 143,690 of 2,037,171 rows) and that the former atomic-threshold rule cannot match the b0_cal_selfdensity realized quota within the unchanged 0.005 global-RD tolerance (nearest gap 0.0206452). The operating point is therefore defined by deterministic exact-quota selection within boundary ties. No model, hyperparameter, comparator, metric, tolerance, seed, or Holm rule changed; artifacts bound to the superseded registration hash are not formal inputs to this registration.
comparator_note: B1/B5 comparison rows are deferred to E3 with their implementations (protocol §5.0.5 instantiation, 2026-07-14). The Stage-1 bar on every axis is the best comparator on that axis (max over B0 and all B0+cal arms). All comparator rows are recomputed by the gate module from the frozen candidate-scores artifact and the committed b0_cal results; values are never copied from result notes.

operating_point.assembly: density-matched threshold on non-self candidate rows against target_edges = |E(strip_self_loops(test_graph))| with atomic tie handling (G1 convention); self-pairs assembled at the same threshold
operating_point.matched_global_rd: for each comparator, select exactly its realized non-self edge count from EgoStitch candidate rows by descending pass-1 score; split only the boundary score tie by ascending canonical pair order (min node index, max node index), without labels or topology targets; assemble self-pairs whose score is at least the selected boundary score; require and disclose |RD_global(egostitch) - RD_global(comparator)| <= 0.005 (the exact-quota construction gives zero gap for a valid quota)
operating_point.scores: Stage-1 scores are pass-1 (ratio-1) scores per spec §13.11; EgoStitch artifacts must declare the §13.16 pair-pass-fp32 precision contract and record descriptive score-resolution diagnostics

primary_criteria.rationale: Headroom-weighted from the completed G3 gate: Oracle-blend clustering-MMD headroom 3.885 is the largest measured axis; Oracle-topo shows GS/local-RD headroom (1.612x / 0.794 vs 0.422). Pure topology signal can regress the degree axis (Oracle-topo degree headroom 0.926), so degree is a guard, not a primary criterion.

criteria.rule: 3-seed mean strictly lower than every comparator, AND the normal-approximation 95% CI of the mean per-seed difference vs the best comparator excludes 0 (see statistics_procedure)
3-seed mean strictly higher than every comparator at matched global simple-edge RD, AND the one-sided p-value vs the best comparator survives Holm
3-seed mean strictly higher than every comparator at matched global simple-edge RD, AND the one-sided p-value vs the best comparator survives Holm

primary_criteria.statistics_procedure: Per metric: per-seed difference d_s = metric(egostitch, seed s) - metric(best comparator on that axis). For clustering_mmd_ratio the per-seed variance additionally includes the bootstrap variance of each side (n_boot=200, bucket-resampling convention of src/eval/graph_metrics.py:bootstrap_mmd): SE^2 = mean_s(var_boot(d_s)) + var_s(d_s)/3. For bfs_macro_gs and bfs_macro_rd (no bootstrap field in AssembledRow), SE^2 = var_s(d_s)/3 (between-seed only; low power at 3 seeds is accepted and mean strict dominance is additionally required). One-sided p = 1 - Phi(mean_s(d_s)/SE) in the beneficial direction. Holm step-down over the 3-member family at alpha=0.05; all three members must survive.

guards.name: degree_mmd_non_regression
guards.rule: 3-seed mean degree-MMD ratio <= 1.10 x the B0 degree-MMD ratio recomputed from the frozen candidate artifact at the G1 operating point

guards.name: matched_edge_auprc
guards.rule: 3-seed mean AUPRC on the degree-corrected ratio-1 regime >= (B0's recomputed value on the same regime) - 0.02; hard-heuristic and hard-feature regime rows are disclosed but not gated at Stage 1

diagnostics_nonbinding: degree-calibration curve: E[d_hat * rho_hat_eval / rho_train] vs realized assembled degree (spec §4.6 transmission evidence)
slot recall@K on train-side G_struct (primary) and disclosed test-side row
slot-adjacency vs true local clustering correlation (Pearson/Spearman)
s-channel correlation matrix over (s0, s1, s2) on validation queries
self/non-self edge-metric split and self-loop-rate row (spec §9.4.3)
proj(x) batch variance trajectory (representation-collapse watch, spec §13.7)
FLOPs and wall-clock table: per-node cached, per-pair marginal, full candidate-universe assembly (proposal §4.7 R=0 commitment)
verdict_rule: pass iff all three primary criteria survive Holm AND both guards hold. Otherwise the verdict is 'cut' and the pre-registered failure reading below is written into the gate results verbatim; criteria are never edited post hoc.
failure_reading: If Stage 1 fails the primary family against B0+cal, the generative imagination apparatus is not load-bearing at this stage (§5.2.1 wording): the calibrated-assembly story is written up honestly and the locked-decision discussion is taken before Stage 2. If Stage 1 fails only against B0 with B0+cal also failing against B0, the assembly-calibration axis is re-examined before mechanisms are cut.
decision_rules_5_2_verbatim: If `Ours` does not beat `B3-full` and `B0+cal` on the held-out assembled family at matched edge AUPRC (Holm-corrected, >= 3 seeds), the generative apparatus is declared not load-bearing; the paper pivots to the benchmark/`B3-full` story.

If s1/s2 knockouts cost nothing on every benchmark and stratum, `Ours -> B5` is declared and the honest small-paper outcome ("calibrated block-model marginals close most of the pair-to-topology gap") is written.
Multiple-comparison control: Holm over the held-out assembled family replaces any "wins on k of n metrics" language.
All thresholds and rules recorded in run metadata before E1/E3 held-out metrics are opened.

mechanics.worker_obligation: src/train_egostitch.py records this file's sha256 as run_metadata.json['preregistration_sha256'] at run start, before the first optimizer step.
mechanics.gate_obligation: src/experiments/g5_stage1.py recomputes this file's sha256 and refuses to open held-out metrics unless it equals the value recorded in every supplied run's run_metadata.json.
mechanics.hyperparameters: spec-default (docs/05-egostitch-spec.md §0/§13) x 3 seeds; the 30-config HPO-parity budget applies at E1/E3, not at this stage gate (protocol §5.0.5 instantiation).
